The festival grounds—set in a valley between ancient pine forests and a wide, meadowed valley—were already buzzing with the promise of music, laughter, and the scent of grilled corn and lavender oil. Children chased each other through cotton-candy-colored tents, and the sky above pulsed with the slow, steady beat of a thousand hearts.
